titleInfo.title: Poorly made in China
titleInfo.subTitle: an insider's account of the tactics behind China's production game

abstract.#text: This true story follows Paul Midler from one project to the next, revealing business and cultural challenges and exposing the dangerous cat-and-mouse games that take place between Chinese companies and their foreign counterparts. It gives an up-close look at the rough-and-tumble environment in which so many of our consumer products are being made.--[book jacket].
